name: Alor Setar Marathon 2026

faqs.answer: The Alor Setar Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on August 14, 2026. The event is held in Alor Setar, Kedah, Malaysia, and includes both full marathon and half marathon distance options for participants who plan to take part on that date.
